## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `security` · `priority:p3` · `domain:services` · `area:access`, into `pm:queue` (`finding` removed). An anonymous caller of an email-audience link gets one refusal, whatever password and email it sends. No decision is needed for that path

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-14T02:58Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Triage's answer to "needs a decision":** only the alternative needs one, an explicit acceptance of allowlist-membership disclosure. The uniform refusal discloses nothing: not membership, not password correctness. It narrows nothing that works today, so the lane can take it without the maintainer. If the seat finds a reason to answer differently by email, that becomes a `[Decision]` card.
- **Why p3 `security`:** today's answer is misleading (a correct password reads as wrong), but it is not an oracle. The console builds no email audience (objectui `ShareDialog.tsx` ~`:128`), so the pull is API and SDK only. The `security` label guards the fix: a naive reorder would create the oracle.
- **Lane:** `plugin-sharing` and its dispatcher twin, `domain:services`, declared in the claim. `Clause-②: no`.
- **Direction:**
  - Both mounts answer an anonymous caller of an email-audience link with one refusal that does not depend on the password or the email sent, until the audience is satisfied.
  - ⛔ No answer that differs by password correctness before the audience is satisfied.
  - **Pins:** on both mounts, (no email or an off-list email) × (wrong or right password) gives one identical answer; an allowlisted email with the right password is served.

## Regrade: p3 → **p1** · `target:v18` · protocol-first rule, all lanes · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-14T08:18Z

Under the maintainer's grading rule, recorded on #6015 (`6163099154`, amended `6163539661`) and extended today, 「立卡，规则扩到所有车道，REST 收窄也算」: every metadata-protocol change, and every narrowing of a REST or data door, is **p1 + `target:v18`** in every lane. The skill text follows in #23431.

- **Why it is in the class:** an anonymous caller who sends the password to a link with an email audience is refused uniformly instead of answered. That is a narrowing at the share-link door, which objectui's share pages call.

Lane, scope and Clause ② are unchanged.

Claim: PM loop round 1 · 2026-10-14T10:42Z · serial, p1 only (the maintainer's scope for this session, opening marker `6166503146` on #6021)
Session: `session_01LxHPTb1LxL7a6WkQbALKnD`
Account: `marchtian` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)

Worktree: `objectstack-issue-23372`
Domain: `domain:services`
Seat: `domain:services#1` (seat post #6021)
File surface: `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/share-link-routes.ts` (the public resolve door's refusal probe) and `packages/runtime/src/domains/share-links.ts` (its dispatcher twin), their tests (`packages/runtime/src/domains/share-links-refusal-order.test.ts`, which holds both mounts to one order, and `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/share-link-*.test.ts`), and one `.changeset/23372-*.md` (stop on breach; explain in the report)
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default — dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack: "no path-derived mandate … The tier stays the PM's per-card judgment call"`; the pre-queue review is at the ceiling, CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER, reason: the same output, "A card that only NARROWS one is `Clause-②: no`, stays in its lane, and owes one contract-review-tier review before the queue"
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `the resolve door's refusal probe on both mounts (plugin-sharing share-link-routes.ts and its runtime twin) picks the refusal answer, and it has no arm for an email audience, so an audience refusal falls through to the password arm | none — resolveToken already refuses on the audience with the undifferentiated null, and only the probe chooses what the caller reads | any anonymous holder of a token for an email-audience link that has a password, through the API or SDK; the console builds no email audience today (card body, objectui ShareDialog.tsx)`
Thread-read: 6164048025
Serial constraints cleared: #23328 landed as `28e294f4` (PR #23369, today 02:57Z), in the same probe block on both mounts; this card builds on it. PR #23440 (draft, #23287) touches `share-link-routes.ts` only in the `refuseHeldSession` docblock, which is disjoint from the probe; the later lander merges `main`. #23371 (p2, `pm:queue`) shares `share-link-routes.ts`. Fold-or-serial: serial, because fold gate ① fails (it is a different defect with a different fix), and it stays behind this card. No other open PR or in-flight claim touches `runtime/src/domains/share-links.ts`. #15204's declared `plugin-sharing` territory (`sharing-rule-service.ts`) is disjoint.

Disclosure: this is a `security` card in this lane. ⛔ No reproduction recipe goes on any public surface (card, PR or comment). Evidence is described abstractly.

## ACCEPT → PR #23471 @ `33934882f849b1fcdd311113e73f86a3b1fb964f`

`domain:services` seat 1 · `marchtian` · `session_01LxHPTb1LxL7a6WkQbALKnD` · 2026-10-14T11:50Z, under claim `6166524822`. The review was against GitHub and `origin/main`, ⛔ not against the report (`6167578994`).

**Checklist**
- **Shape:** draft, base `main`. The body's first line is `Fixes #23372`, and no other closing keyword sits beside an open card number (the only other reference, #23328, is closed and carries no keyword). The `Clause-②: no` line is at the start of a line.
- **Scope:** 4 files, all inside the claim's surface: the two probes, `share-links-refusal-order.test.ts` and `.changeset/23372-share-link-email-audience-uniform-refusal.md`. No `content/docs/releases/`.
- **Changeset:** `patch` for `@objectstack/plugin-sharing` and `@objectstack/runtime`, both published (no `private`). I read each sentence against the diff:
  - "404 INVALID_OR_EXPIRED … signed in or not": holds. The arm reads neither the email nor the session.
  - "Unchanged: … the expired-or-revoked 410 EXPIRED_OR_REVOKED": holds. The plugin arm sits inside the live-row block, and the twin's arm is guarded by `live &&`.
  - "a public link's NEEDS_PASSWORD / WRONG_PASSWORD": holds. `public` is an audience (`ShareLinkAudience`), and its arms are untouched.
- **Spot readings on the diff:**
  - Each probe gains one arm, `row.audience === 'email'`, which returns the existing `invalidOrExpired()` helper. It is placed after the `signed_in` arm and before the password arm.
  - No ledger code is added, and `error-code-ledger.zod.ts` is untouched, so `Clause-②: no` holds.
  - `resolveToken` is unchanged.
- **Pins:**
  - They live in the one table that holds both mounts, so a divergence between the mounts fails there.
  - Every refusal row asserts `status` and `error.code`. Three pins compare whole answers (status, envelope and headers): no password oracle, no membership oracle, and the unknown-token answer.
  - The pins were committed red before the fix: 24 failed on `main`'s probes, 12 per mount.
  - Ablation ran on both mounts, with two legs each. A1 (the arm removed) turns 12 red. A2 (the arm answering by email, the oracle) turns 5 red, including the membership pin.
- **Direction check:** the after-grid puts every refusal cell of an `email` link on one answer, an allowlisted email with a wrong password included. That cell is what the card's rule forces ("⛔ No answer that differs by password correctness before the audience is satisfied", with "satisfied" here being an unverified claim). The PR body's oracle argument records why. Nothing answers by email, so by triage's rule (`6159876342`) no `[Decision]` card is owed.
- **Deviations accepted:**
  - the shallow fetch of a gate's pinned control commit, which moved no ref;
  - the long hold of the verify lock;
  - commit trailers in the AGENTS.md form.
- **Out-of-scope findings:**
  - `/messages` forwards neither the recipient email (both mounts) nor the signed-in user (plugin mount) to `resolveToken`. Folded into #23371 as the family's closing card (`6167657863`). ⛔ No single-point card.
  - The `email` audience is satisfied by the caller's own unverified `?email=` claim. Recorded in Acceptance notes, through the PR body's "The oracle argument". Not filed at this act: the issue-search read failed its positive control (it did not return this card), so no dedupe was possible. Carried to the seat's round report.
- **Product cost, open to the maintainer's veto:** an allowlisted recipient who mistypes the password now reads "invalid, expired, or revoked", where they read "Incorrect password" before. The no-oracle rule forces this, because that cell must equal the off-list cell.

**Landing (pending; the seat holds it):**
1. Every check is green on `33934882` (it was converging at this read).
2. A contract-review-tier record on this head (`Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`) reads PASS. That reviewer is running, isolated and read-only.

Then `pr_ready` and `automerge_enable` go through the relay. The path face is not governed (no `.claude/**`, `docs/adr/**`, `skills/**`, `.github/workflows/**` or `AGENTS.md`), and the diff is 182 lines, under the 3000-line human-merge threshold.
